newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end firm awaiting terms on new issue.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end firm awaiting terms on new issue.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Swiss bonds ended firm before conclusion of the Swiss government's bond auction on Thursday. Terms are expected to be announced for the new bond at around 1100 GMT.
* Sept Conf futures end 25 basis points higher at 120.93.
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.358 pct vs 3.40 pct.
